tableLines.line: "Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Elif speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

👂 Overheard — Ingrid (to James): "Kumaran's story has a fresh coat of paint." Ingrid taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get from Johannesburg, South Africa. Just don't scrape it in front of them."

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The little star inside Zakaria goes quiet — and wakes up inside Ingrid. Zakaria never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Ingrid will never be hungry again while it hums, and Zakaria is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.

◈ OVERTIME ×1 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+25% HP, +12% damage). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −13. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 20 days between tiers, not 7.
✨ Ability gained: Harvest Table (L1). Your feasts are rituals. Every feast you host arms the feast surge even without devotion (x1.3 at least), and each guest leaves trusting you a little more.

scaleLines.line: You don't know what that was. A walking courthouse. Someone at the haven should hear about this.

🧳 Word of Haven’s new bindings, the televised games is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: Thornfield and Stonebridge have bound together — Thornfield primary. Other fires are climbing, too.

🧳 The trader lowers their voice. "And further still — FOUR fires under one head. They call it a REALM. Tribute flows uphill like a river; I saw the grain carts with my own eyes." They won't say more. Or can't.
Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
